Name: Run Code Execution Agent Sandbox
Author: cbf81976-f755-4f3f-83fd-a1b7e124ac7f
Description: Launches an advanced Google ADK Agent equipped with a secure, isolated Python execution sandbox. The agent can dynamically write, execute, and inspect Python code to solve complex, non-linear analytical problems (e.g. log parsing, mathematical computations, data transformation, or nested JSON formatting) within a SOAR playbook. Reasoning thoughts, generated Python code snippets, execution logs, and the final response are automatically consolidated into a  single, beautiful Markdown report card on the Case Wall.

Parameters.DefaultValue: Calculate the first 10 numbers in the fibonacci sequence
